SELECT MEMBER_CODE, PHONE, EMAIL, NAME, STATUS, INPUT_DATE
FROM (
SELECT A.*, ROWNUM RN
FROM (
SELECT M.MEMBER_CODE, M.PHONE, M.EMAIL, M.NAME, M.STATUS, M.INPUT_DATE
FROM MEMBER M
AND ( M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' OR M.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' )
AND M.STATUS = #{searchDTO.status}
ORDER BY M.MEMBER_CODE DESC ) A
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} )
WHERE RN >= #{startRow}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM MEMBER M
AND ( M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' OR M.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' )
AND M.STATUS = #{searchDTO.status}

SELECT M.MEMBER_CODE, M.PHONE, M.EMAIL, M.ZIPCODE, M.ADDRESS, M.ADDRESS2, M.NAME, M.STATUS, M.HUMAN_DATE, M.SMS_RECEIVE, M.EMAIL_RECEIVE, M.IMAGE, M.INPUT_DATE,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM RESERVATION R
WHERE R.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE
) AS RESERVATION_NUM,
( SELECT NVL(SUM(P.AMOUNT), 0)
FROM RESERVATION R
INNER JOIN PAYMENT P ON P.RESERVATION_CODE = R.RESERVATION_CODE
WHERE R.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE AND P.STATUS = '결제완료'
) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM RESERVATION R
WHERE R.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE AND R.STATUS = '취소'
) AS CANCEL_COUNT,
( SELECT MAX(LH.LOGIN_DATE)
FROM LOGIN_HISTORY LH
WHERE LH.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE
) AS LAST_LOGIN_DATE
FROM MEMBER M
WHERE M.MEMBER_CODE = #{memberCode}

SELECT RESERVATION_CODE, CLASS_CODE, CLASS_NAME, RESERVATION_DATE, PEOPLE_NUMBER, RESERVATION_STATUS, PAYMENT_CODE, AMOUNT, MEANS, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_STATUS, REFUND, REFUND_DATE
FROM (
SELECT A.*, ROWNUM RN
FROM (
SELECT R.RESERVATION_CODE, R.CLASS_CODE,
C.NAME AS CLASS_NAME,
R.RESERVATION_DATE, R.PEOPLE_NUMBER,
R.STATUS AS RESERVATION_STATUS,
P.PAYMENT_CODE, P.AMOUNT, P.MEANS, P.PAYMENT_DATE,
P.STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS,
P.REFUND, P.REFUND_DATE
FROM RESERVATION R
INNER JOIN CLASS C ON C.CLASS_CODE = R.CLASS_CODE
LEFT JOIN PAYMENT P ON P.RESERVATION_CODE = R.RESERVATION_CODE
WHERE R.MEMBER_CODE = #{memberCode}
ORDER BY R.RESERVATION_DATE DESC, R.RESERVATION_CODE DESC
) A
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow}
)
WHERE RN >= #{startRow}

SELECT R.RESERVATION_CODE, R.CLASS_CODE, C.NAME AS CLASS_NAME, R.RESERVATION_DATE, R.PEOPLE_NUMBER, R.STATUS AS RESERVATION_STATUS, P.PAYMENT_CODE, P.AMOUNT, P.MEANS, P.PAYMENT_DATE, P.STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS, P.REFUND, P.REFUND_DATE FROM RESERVATION R JOIN CLASS C ON R.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE LEFT JOIN PAYMENT P ON R.RESERVATION_CODE = P.RESERVATION_CODE WHERE R.RESERVATION_CODE = #{reservationCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT SET REFUND = AMOUNT, STATUS = '환불완료', REFUND_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE RESERVATION_CODE = #{reservationCode} AND STATUS = '결제완료'
UPDATE RESERVATION SET STATUS = '취소' WHERE RESERVATION_CODE = #{reservationCode} AND STATUS = '예약'
